2609.29995.title: Guardrails or Roadblocks? Effects of Pedagogical Style and Context Awareness in AI Teaching Assistants for Programming
2609.29995.paper_summary: AI teaching assistants (AI TAs) backed by large language models (LLMs) and pedagogical guardrails are increasingly being integrated into programming courses, providing students with scalable access to hints, conceptual explanations, and code-level feedback. However, guardrails may also create friction. If students feel that the support provided is overly restrictive or poorly contextualized to their current progress, they may bypass approved tools for general-purpose LLMs. To investigate how AI TA design affects students' learning experiences, we conducted a randomized controlled trial with 132 students in an introductory programming course. Students completed three tasks related to code-writing and debugging and were randomly assigned to one of four AI TAs varied across two dimensions: pedagogical guidance style (Socratic vs. Direct instruction) and context awareness (no context vs. full context of the problem and student solution). We examined students' perceptions, interaction behaviors, and evidence of post-task comprehension. Students rated the Socratic AI TA with full context least favorably, reporting significantly lower perceived support for task completion. Descriptively, this condition also showed the highest observed interaction stress, the highest rate of external LLM use, and the lowest proportion of post-task explanations demonstrating full comprehension, though these differences were not statistically significant. These findings suggest that guardrailed AI TAs are not automatically better for learning. Instead, their effectiveness depends on how pedagogical guidance and contextual awareness are balanced in ways that students experience as useful, supportive, and worth continuing to use.
2609.29995.paper_summary_zh: AI 教學助理（AI TAs）由大型語言模型（LLMs）和教學護欄支持，越來越多地被整合進程式設計課程中，為學生提供可擴展的提示、概念解釋和代碼級反饋的訪問。然而，護欄也可能會產生摩擦。如果學生感覺所提供的支持過於限制或與他們當前的進度不夠相關，他們可能會繞過經批准的工具，轉而使用通用的 LLMs。為了調查 AI TA 設計如何影響學生的學習體驗，我們對 132 名參加入門程式設計課程的學生進行了一項隨機對照試驗。學生完成了三個與代碼編寫和調試相關的任務，並隨機分配到四個 AI TAs 中的其中一個，這四個 AI TAs 在兩個維度上有所不同：教學指導風格（蘇格拉底式與直接指導）和上下文意識（無上下文與問題和學生解決方案的完整上下文）。我們檢查了學生的感知、互動行為和任務後理解的證據。學生對具有完整上下文的蘇格拉底式 AI TA 的評價最低，報告顯示對任務完成的支持感知顯著較低。描述性地，這一條件也顯示出最高的觀察到的互動壓力、最高的外部 LLM 使用率，以及最低的顯示完全理解的任務後解釋比例，儘管這些差異在統計上並不顯著。這些發現表明，受護欄限制的 AI TAs 並不自動更有利於學習。相反，它們的有效性取決於如何平衡教學指導和上下文意識，以學生感受到的有用性、支持性和持續使用的價值為基準。
